text:
Lena V.: Kickoff: IronVault (secrets manager) + SecuBridge (SI/HSM integrator). Scope: SP-initiated SAML, SCIM v2 provisioning, KMS passthrough to SecuBridge-managed HSMs, and a marketplace "HSM-backed" SKU. Who owns which bits?

Ravi P.: I can own SAML/SP metadata + attribute mapping. Quick ask: will we require signed assertions and want email as NameID?

Tess G.: Ill own marketplace copy and embargo logistics. Proposed public date 2026-08-12, embargo 08-05. Need final feature checklist by 07-28.

Omar H.: Ill do KMS passthrough + attestation verification. SecuBridge wants mTLS + JWS attestation proving key origin. Also they want support for RSA-OAEP and HKDF-wrapped keys.

Lena V.: Partners requested SCIM minimal attrs: userName, givenName, familyName, active, groups. They want group sync to map to entitlements in marketplace.

Ravi P.: SAML checklist: send SP metadata (ACS, EntityID), request IdP metadata from SecuBridge, confirm assertion signing algorithm (RSASSA-PSS ok?). Ill post a short metadata snippet in repo.

Omar H.: Minimal KMS test curl for partner sandbox:
```
curl -X POST https://kms.redwood.example.com/wrap \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"key_id":"secubridge-hsm-1","plaintext":"<base64>"}' \ 
  --cert int-client.pem --key int-client.key --cacert secubridge-ca.pem
```
We should provide a test client cert or accept their test certs.

Tess G.: Marketplace SKU draft: "IronVault (Hosted)" and "IronVault + SecuBridge HSM (Dedicated)". HSM SKU will show "HSM-backed" badge and contact-sales pricing. Need UX mock and short compatibility note for Private deployments.

Lena V.: Action items: @Ravi prepare SP metadata + SAML test plan; @Omar draft KMS passthrough spec + attestation validation; @Tess create SKU mock + embargo timeline; Ill coordinate partner outreach and legal approvals.

Ravi P.: Short SAML snippet Ill share:
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
Will add full metadata to partners repo.

Omar H.: Also adding attestation verifier that checks JWS claim `hsm:attested = true` and key origin. Will push tests.

PartnerBot: External invites sent to eng@ironvault.io and infra@secubridge.com for integration call: https://meet.example.com/ironvault-secubridge

Tess G.: Ill request quotes and logos by 07-20 per legal note.

Lena V.: Great. Schedule 45m tech workshop next Wed 09:30 PT? Who can join?

Ravi P.: In.

Omar H.: In.

Tess G.: Ill join the first 15 for go-to-market sync.

Lena V.: Perfect. Post any blockers here. :rocket:
